"In the local agent package folder /tmp/apar-desk/run-9dys/autobyteus-agents, change these files directly on disk (no git, no other changes, no reviews, no questions):
1. In agents/apar-haiku-poet/agent.md keep the front matter, and replace the body instructions with exactly: `Reply with exactly one haiku about the requested topic, then a final line MARK_POET_V2.`
2. Replace agent-teams/apar-poetry-duo/team-config.json with exactly: {"coordinatorMemberName": "lead", "members": [{"memberName": "lead", "ref": "apar-haiku-poet", "refScope": "shared"}, {"memberName": "analyst", "ref": "data-engineer", "refScope": "shared"}], "handoffs": [{"from": "/lead", "to": "/analyst", "rules": ["Hand over any data question."]}], "avatarUrl": null, "defaultLaunchConfig": null}
3. Delete the folder agents/apar-desk-scout entirely.
Report back exactly what you changed."

When the creator reports back, tell me in one line.
